## Code Review Report

### Review Summary

This branch cleanly introduces the Python-native prompt loader and typed pipeline handoff dataclasses, and the implementation itself looks sound. Main problems sit around the prompt-file relocation follow-through: several live documentation and maintenance references still point at `.opencode/agents/` even though targeted verification shows that directory now contains only `.gitkeep`, and the relocation regression test was weakened enough that it no longer proves the moved prompt set is intact.

**Files Reviewed:** 26  
**Findings:** 0 Critical, 3 Warning, 0 Suggestion

### Findings

#### Critical Findings

None.

#### Warning Findings

[W-01] Live documentation still points to the retired agent prompt directory
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: README.md, AGENTS.md, .github/notes/architecture.md
Lines: 189; 28; 112-118
Description: This PR relocates the canonical agent prompt files from `.opencode/agents/` to `prompts/agents/`, and the migration PRD explicitly marks that relocation as complete. However, three live documentation surfaces still instruct readers to look in `.opencode/agents/`. Targeted verification shows `.opencode/agents/` now contains only `.gitkeep`, so these references now point to an empty directory. That leaves both human contributors and agent workflows consulting the knowledge base with an incorrect prompt location.
Suggestion: Update all live documentation references to `prompts/agents/` and reserve `.opencode/agents/` mentions for explicitly historical context only.

[W-02] Savepoint maintenance comment now points at the wrong companion file
Category: Documentation
Severity: Warning
File: src/tools/savepoint_manager.py
Lines: 137-139
Description: The `CANONICAL_PHASES` comment still says the companion Savepoint Strategy table lives in `.opencode/agents/story-orchestrator.md`. After this PR, that file path is obsolete. Future maintainers following the comment will update the wrong file and can easily leave the real prompt definition in `prompts/agents/story-orchestrator.md` out of sync with the code.
Suggestion: Change the comment to reference `prompts/agents/story-orchestrator.md` or another still-authoritative phase-order document.

[W-03] Relocation regression test no longer proves the moved prompt set is preserved
Category: Testing
Severity: Warning
File: tests/unit/test_prompt_relocation.py
Lines: 107-111
Description: The changed assertion now checks only that the total number of Markdown files under `prompts/` is at least 148. That is much weaker than the stated goal in the test docstring and in the migration PRD, which is to preserve the relocated prompt set. A missing or renamed file under `prompts/agents/` would still pass as soon as any unrelated Markdown file is added elsewhere under `prompts/`.
Suggestion: Assert the exact expected filenames under `prompts/agents/` or at minimum assert the exact agent-prompt count and the presence of each relocated file by stem.

### Overall Assessment

Not ready for merge yet. Core code in `src/infrastructure/prompts/agent_prompt_loader.py` and `src/application/pipeline/handoffs.py` is straightforward and well-covered by the new unit tests, but the relocation work is incomplete at the documentation and maintenance-contract level, and the loosened relocation test would not reliably catch regressions in the moved prompt set. Fix the stale `.opencode/agents/` references in live docs/comments and tighten the relocation assertion before merge.
